channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Local Transcriber — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that records calls and meetings and transcribes them on-device with Whisper, with speaker recognition, call detection and dictation into any app.

item.title: Strata Files — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane.

item.title: Siliconed — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app for local AI image generation and instruction-based image editing on Apple silicon, written in Swift and Metal.

item.title: Photo Review — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool that lists an iCloud Photos library by size, then compresses large videos or deletes what you pick.

item.title: LawPulse — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local-first legal research tool for Chinese lawyers: offline statute library with per-article notes; all data stays on your Mac.

item.title: JoeBro — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native SwiftUI workspace for chat and document editing with local models via Ollama or any API, plus memory, MCP tools, and deep research.

item.title: FanPilot — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fan control and temperature monitor for Apple Silicon Macs: menu bar temps, manual, max, Auto Boost rules or custom curves, with a fail-safe helper and a CLI.

item.title: Aman Check — via awesome-mac
item.description: Dated, honest condition report for a used Mac: locks, battery, SSD and guided hardware tests.

item.title: ftop — via awesome-mac
item.description: Floating system monitor for Apple Silicon that adapts its layout to any window size, showing per-core usage and frequency, GPU, memory pressure, and network.

item.title: OpenClean — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free, open-source Mac cleaner that explains every item before removal and quarantines anything not trivially rebuilt so you can restore it. Includes an app uninstaller, disk map and menu bar monitor.

item.title: JET Pilot — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Kubernetes desktop client for working across clusters, namespaces and cloud accounts.

item.title: Utter — via awesome-mac
item.description: On-device voice dictation and meeting transcription powered by whisper.cpp and Metal.

item.title: Termstead — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native SSH client with a session tree, jump hosts and SFTP beside the terminal.

item.title: Songtide — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native YouTube Music app with an equalizer, visualizer and synced lyrics.

item.title: Pulse — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native app that shows how much Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and 70+ other AI coding services you have left, as rings docked at the edge of your screen.

item.title: Lemma — via awesome-mac
item.description: PDF reader for mathematics textbooks and papers that turns theorem and equation references into links, folds proofs and checks the derivations you write.

item.title: Hongguo Drama — via awesome-mac
item.description: Unofficial player and downloader for Chinese short dramas from Hongguo, Xifan, and Hema, for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

item.title: yovoice — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local voice creation studio with text-to-speech, voice cloning, emotion control, song generation and MIDI scoring, all running on-device.

item.title: akou — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source call and meeting recorder that transcribes on-device with speaker labels and lets Claude Code or Codex question a call over MCP.

item.title: Sitch — via awesome-mac
item.description: Skitch-style screenshot annotation with tapered arrows, blur, and pixelate, fully offline.

item.title: Sentinel — via awesome-mac
item.description: Plain-language Mac security-settings check with a Wi-Fi device list.

item.title: TunnelFlow — via awesome-mac
item.description: Modern SSH tunnel and port forwarding manager supporting local, remote, and dynamic SOCKS5 forwards.

item.title: Snappy — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source, Ubuntu-style screenshot tool with an adjustable selection, window and full-screen capture, markup, blur, and text copying.

item.title: Keyameleon — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool that gives each physical keyboard its own input source and switches to it automatically as you type.

item.title: Headroom — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fast disk space analyzer with a treemap and duplicate finder that labels caches and developer folders Safe, Caution or Never before you delete them.

item.title: Findly — via awesome-mac
item.description: Finder-style file drawer that slides in from any screen edge with a hotkey and slides away when you switch apps.

item.title: inlaut — via awesome-mac
item.description: Fully local push-to-talk dictation for German and English, running a Parakeet model on-device and typing at the cursor.

item.title: MemStats — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar memory monitor that splits RAM usage by user account, groups helper processes into apps, and shows memory pressure and swap.

item.title: FreeDisplay — via awesome-mac
item.description: Control external display brightness, HiDPI modes, resolution, and arrangement from the menu bar.

item.title: FreeAudio — via awesome-mac
item.description: Per-app volume and mute, output device switching, and volume control for HDMI/DisplayPort monitors.

item.title: FinderRight — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Finder extension that adds new file, open in terminal, copy path, and cut & paste to the right-click menu.

item.title: Device Hub Pro — via awesome-mac
item.description: Mirror, control and test Android emulators and phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side.

item.title: Caplo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Screen recorder and editor with automatic camera moves, cursor effects, canvas, and captions.

item.title: Boost — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free memory without closing apps, freeze apps and restore them exactly as they were, and find disk space that's genuinely safe to reclaim.

item.title: QDuo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Popup at the cursor that runs your own actions on selected text in any app: AI prompts, search, text transforms, Shortcuts, and shell scripts.

item.title: Sesame — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app that indexes the dashboards, reports, sites, PRs, and files Claude Code and Codex delivered, and reopens them when you type or say a few words.

item.title: Redlamp — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native, open-source raw photo editor that keeps Lightroom Classic's Develop workflow.

item.title: Quail — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local model server for GGUF and MLX models on Apple silicon, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs for tools like Claude Code and Codex.

item.title: Mooziac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight native macOS menu bar player for YouTube Music & local audio.

item.title: Farol — via awesome-mac
item.description: Terminal built on libghostty that shows which coding agent is working, waiting or done.

item.title: IPTVMac — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native IPTV player for Xtream Codes and M3U with instant search, mpv playback, Picture in Picture and downloads.

item.title: mu — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source coding agent with a CLI and a desktop app, in which a small judge model makes routine calls such as what enters the context and whether a flagged command was asked for.

item.title: Sonar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native music player with synchronized lyrics and menu bar and notch playback controls.

item.title: ThinkWatch Lite — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local gateway for Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding clients that switches upstreams without client changes, records the cost of each request, and redacts API keys before requests leave.

item.title: MAC-LIMPO — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar cleaner for developer caches (Xcode, Docker, simulators, node_modules) with a 2D/3D disk usage treemap.

item.title: WhisperDrop 2 — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source local transcription for audio, video, YouTube, and meetings, with dictation into any app.

item.title: Rapid Reader — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source RSVP speed reader for EPUB, PDF, and web articles with a full-text view.

item.title: OpenNaga — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Razer Synapse alternative for the Naga V2 HyperSpeed that remaps the side buttons and sets DPI and polling rate.

item.title: DataNexa — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source desktop database MCP gateway that aggregates multiple databases into a single access point with read-only enforcement and auditing for AI agents.

item.title: OpenSpatial — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source spatial audio for any headphones, playing every app as 7.1 surround with head tracking.
